graveless.configuration.title: Graveless
graveless.configuration.enabled.tooltip: Master switch for Graveless death handling.
graveless.configuration.max_records_per_: Maximum death records retained per player.
graveless.configuration.max_backups_per_: Maximum archived grave backup files kept on disk per player. -1 keeps every backup forever.
graveless.configuration.visibility_radiu: Distance in blocks at which grave ghosts are sent to nearby players and remain visible.
graveless.configuration.claim_range.tool: Maximum distance in blocks from which a ghost can be claimed. Aim passes through blocks.
graveless.configuration.require_line_of_: Require an unobstructed view of the ghost to claim it. Claims no longer work through walls.
graveless.configuration.protection_enabl: Grant invisibility, night vision, and safety from mobs when approaching your own grave.
graveless.configuration.protection_range: Distance in blocks from your own grave at which Spirit Ward is granted.
graveless.configuration.protection_durat: How long Spirit Ward lasts in seconds if the grave is not claimed.
graveless.configuration.protection_linge: How long Spirit Ward lingers in seconds after claiming the grave.
graveless.configuration.use_shaders.tool: Use the custom ghost shader. Disable to fall back to plain translucent rendering.
graveless.death.saved: Your belongings (%s items) rest where you fell: %s, %s, %s in %s
graveless.hud.in_range: Your spirit lingers %s blocks %s. Look toward it and click to reclaim what was lost.
graveless.claim.blocked: Something stands between you and your spirit. Find a clear line of sight.
graveless.restore.partial: Recovered %s items. %s did not fit and remain in your grave.
graveless.restore.complete: Recovered %s items. Your grave is at peace.
graveless.command.allowed: %s may now see and recover your graves.
graveless.command.denied: %s may no longer access your graves.
graveless.command.cleared: Removed %s players from your grave access list.
graveless.command.enabled: Graveless is active for you. Your items will be kept safe on death.
graveless.command.disabled: Graveless is disabled for you. Your items will drop on death.
graveless.command.restore.done: Restored %s items to %s (%s items left in the grave).
graveless.command.backups.header: Grave backups for %s (%s files, newest first, showing up to 10):
graveless.command.restorebackup.done: Backup #%s revived as a new grave (%s items) for %s. Their ghost stands again.
graveless.command.prune.unlimited: Backup retention is set to unlimited. Pass a keep count to prune anyway, or set max_backups_per_player in the server config.
graveless.command.prune.player: Pruned %s archived grave files for %s, keeping the newest %s.
graveless.command.prune.all: Pruned %s archived grave files from %s of %s players, keeping the newest %s each.
graveless.menu.title: GRAVELESS
graveless.menu.overlay.access_empty: ONLY YOU CAN SEE YOUR GRAVES
graveless.menu.extract_hint: Sneak + left click to extract to your inventory
graveless.menu.owner_offline: That player is not online, so their grave cannot be restored right now.
graveless.menu.deleted: Grave entry deleted. %s items were released to the void.
item.graveless.spirit_compass.tooltip: The needle seeks your lingering spirit. Hold it and follow, or use it to commune with your graves.
